recentItems.title: CHINA’S TRAP FOR PUTIN: Xi Jinping demands Russian gas for DIRT CHEAP!
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian strikes are increasing pressure on Russia's strategic infrastructure: drones attacked the port of Ust-Luga, while one of the country's largest oil refineries lost most of its capacity. Amid growing fuel troubles, the Kremlin is also facing deepening economic dependence on China. Putin met with Xi Jinping in an attempt to secure Beijing's continued support and negotiate the Power of Siberia 2 gas pipeline. Why China is dictating terms to Moscow and how the war is shifting the balance of power between the two nations — in this new episode.

recentItems.title: PUTIN'S FATAL MISCALCULATION: NATO completely changes the rules of the game!
recentItems.description:
NATO is changing its approach to the Russian threat, drawing on the experience of four years of full-scale war. Admiral Giuseppe Cavo Dragone, Chair of the NATO Military Committee, explained why strengthening Ukrainian air defense remains one of the top priorities and what lessons the Allies are already learning from the Ukrainian Armed Forces. Today, Ukraine is not only receiving military support, but is also making a significant contribution to the security of all of Europe. Moscow, according to the admiral, miscalculated when it expected the West to grow tired and divided. The main message to the Kremlin remains unchanged: Ukraine is not alone.

recentItems.title: Gasoline collapse in Russia GOES BEYOND BORDERS: Russians stealing fuel from Kazakhstan!
recentItems.description:
Russia is increasingly feeling the impact of strikes on its oil infrastructure: oil refining has dropped to its lowest level in over 20 years, and residents of border regions are traveling to Kazakhstan for fuel. At the same time, Moscow's neighbors are developing their own energy ties and becoming less dependent on Russia. Against this backdrop, the Kremlin is intensifying air terror against Ukraine, launching thousands of attack drones. We analyze the fuel crisis in Russia, Ukrainian Armed Forces strikes on oil refineries and military targets, and Moscow's attempts to exhaust Ukrainian air defense with mass attacks.
